subject: Org access charter: ArcadiaHealth pilot - API keys & admin invites
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Martinez <s.martinez@arcadiahealth.com>, Josh Reynolds <josh.reynolds@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Mar 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Org access charter: ArcadiaHealth pilot - API keys & admin invites

Hi Sofia / Josh —

Great to connect yesterday. As discussed, this thread will capture the kickoff items for the ArcadiaHealth pilot (3-week internal evaluation + one small production route). Goal is to have a working environment with seeded API keys and admin users by the end of next week so your engineers can exercise the integration.

Key asks to start implementation planning:
- Please confirm the pilot project name you want us to create (we'll create a Redwood project and seed API keys scoped to it).
- Provide a short list of 2–3 workspace admins (name + email + role) — attached is a CSV template (arcadia-admin-roster.csv).
- Any constraints on API key expiry, IP allowlists, or regional data residency (if applicable).

What we will deliver before handoff to CS:
- One project created in your org with two admin API keys (one primary, one rollback).
- Seeded roles and permission map based on your roster.
- MCP Onboarding Checklist completed and shared (attached).

Proposed timeline:
1) Today: Receive admin roster + pilot project name.
2) Mon-Wed: We seed the project, create keys, and run a smoke test.
3) Thu: Handoff call with implementation owner and your engineers.

I've attached the onboarding checklist and a draft MPA for legal to review. Monica & Ben — once Sofia confirms the roster, can you own key seeding and schedule the smoke-test window?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: arcadia-admin-roster.csv (text/csv), MCP-Onboarding-Checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), MPA-draft-Arcadia-20250322.pdf (pdf)

From: Sofia Martinez <s.martinez@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Cc: Josh Reynolds <josh.reynolds@arcadiahealth.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Mar 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Org access charter: ArcadiaHealth pilot - API keys & admin invites

Thanks Aditya — we liked the plan. A couple quick notes:
- Pilot project name: arcadia-pilot-telemetry
- Admins (attached as arcadia-admin-roster.csv): Sofia Martinez (ops), Josh Reynolds (eng lead), plus contractor Alan Chu (integration).
- For keys: we prefer 90-day expiry and IP allowlist for our staging CIDR; final production keys will follow stricter rotation once we move past pilot.

Question: do Redwood API keys support scoped read-only tokens for analytics? Our analytics team will want read-only to embeddings + logs. Also, who should we expect as the SOC2 contact for data handling questions?

I'll loop in legal if they have comments on the MPA.

Sofia
Sofia Martinez
Director, Platform Operations
Arcadia Health

Attachments: arcadia-admin-roster.csv (text/csv)

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Mar 2025 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Org access charter: ArcadiaHealth pilot - API keys & admin invites

Aditya — thanks for the details. I've reviewed the roster Sofia sent. Proposed internal owners: Ben will handle key seeding and IP allowlist config; I'll own role mapping and the smoke test plan; Laura, please pencil in time Thursday for the handoff call.

Notes for seeding:
- Create project: arcadia-pilot-telemetry
- Two keys: arcadia-primary (admin), arcadia-rollback (admin, locked until confirmed)
- Generate an additional read-only token for analytics: arcadia-ro-analytics (scoped to embeddings + logs).
- Set key expiry to 90 days and add staging CIDR: 35.210.0.0/16 (confirmed by Sofia).

Ben — I'll send the permissions matrix in a follow-up (MCP-Onboarding-Checklist.xlsx will have the template). If legal gives redlines on the MPA, pause final key issuance until we confirm any contractual constraints.

-Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Martinez <s.martinez@arcadiahealth.com>, Josh Reynolds <josh.reynolds@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Mar 2025 10:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Org access charter: ArcadiaHealth pilot - API keys & admin invites

Sofia — perfect, thanks for the quick turnaround and the roster. To answer your question: yes, we can mint scoped read-only tokens for analytics and logging (they are limited to embeddings + read-only access to audit logs). Our SOC2 primary contact is Priya Natarajan on the privacy team (priya@redwood.ai); I'll introduce her if legal has any questions.

Proposed schedule update:
- Tue (03/25) morning: Ben seeds keys in a staging project and shares encrypted key values via our secure vault link.
- Wed (03/26) 11:00am PT: Smoke test with Arcadia devs.
- Thu (03/27) 09:00am PT: Handoff call with implementation owner and ops.

Sofia — can you confirm Wed 11am PT for the smoke test? If so we'll lock the calendar invite.

Also attaching the MPA draft for reference (we'll wait for legal redlines).

Thanks,
Aditya

Attachments: MPA-draft-Arcadia-20250322.pdf (pdf)

On Mon, Mar 24, 2025 at 10:34 AM Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Sofia — perfect, thanks for the quick turnaround and the roster. ...

Confirming: Wed 03/26 at 11:00am PT works for our team. We'll have one backend engineer (me) and one FE engineer on the call. A couple of requests ahead of time:
- Please share the vault link to retrieve keys after Ben seeds them.
- Can the read-only analytics token include a 6-month TTL option (we prefer fewer rotations for analytics, but 90-day OK for admin keys)?

We will bring legal comments to the handoff if they appear sooner. Looking forward to the call.

Josh
Engineering Lead, Arcadia Health

Attachments: signed-order-arcadia-v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>

- Create 'arcadia-pilot-telemetry' project in Redwood Private staging for ArcadiaHealth.
- Seed keys: arcadia-primary, arcadia-rollback, arcadia-ro-analytics. Use 90d TTL for admin keys, 180d TTL for the analytics token per Josh's request (confirm scope: embeddings + logs).
- Apply staging CIDR allowlist 35.210.0.0/16 to admin keys.
- Upload key values to secure vault and share vault link with Josh.
- Schedule the smoke test: Wed 03/26 11:00am PT (calendar invite sent).

Internal notes (do not forward externally):
- Wait on final MPA countersign before creating production keys.
- Tag resources with deal_id=AH-2025-042 and owner=aditya_rao for billing/tracking.

Monica, Ben — can you confirm ownership here? Laura, please take point on the handoff call and run the smoke test script in the checklist.
